units: px are 1x screen pixels (double at 2x zoom); times in seconds; colours sRGB hex or linear multipliers

attach.doc: Offsets from the character pivot (feet, bottom-centre). Head top for 48x64 survivors/zombies is ~46 px above the pivot; brute (64x80) ~60 px.

wet.inputs: survival wetness level 0..3 -> wetness byte 0, 85, 170, 255 (w = byte/255)
wet.mask: <atlas>_sheen.png from survival_fx/tools/make_sheen_mask.py (R sheen, G darken weight, B drip-start, A alpha)
wet.shader: col *= mix(1, darkenTint, G*w*0.9); col = sat(col, 1 + 0.10*w); col += sheenColor * R * w * sheenStrength * (0.75 + 0.25*sin(t*2 + x*0.3))

drips.spawn: random pixel with B > 0.5 in the current frame, else headTop+(±8, 4..30)

feetSplash.when: on footstep while standing on a puddle tile or rain>0.3

cold.inputs: cold level 0..3 (0 comfy, 1 chilly, 2 cold, 3 freezing)

tint.skinOnly: optional: weight by (1 - sheen.G) which is high on skin, giving blue cheeks/nose

shiver.axis: x (sprite-space), random phase per entity, 0.25 s bursts every 0.8-1.6 s

breath.alsoWhen: ambient temperature < 5C even if not cold

exhausted.inputs: stamina fraction s (0..1); exhausted when s < 0.15, tired when s < 0.35

droop.note: optional 3% vertical squash about the pivot while exhausted (droopy-eyes idea without masks)

campfire.note: gameplay piece campfire: heat 18, heatRadius 4 tiles, lightRadius 8 (ADR-215); size anims are visual only

lightCookies.fire: survival_fx/textures/light_cookie_fire_256.png (rotate slowly 0.1 rad/s, multiply onto the round cookie for lobed flicker)
lightCookies.window: survival_fx/textures/light_cookie_window_256.png (skew to the wall face, project onto the ground in front of the window)
lightCookies.note: grayscale, power-of-two, squash 2:1 for iso; pick the smallest size >= on-screen diameter

heatRing.scaleToRadius: sprite is 256x128 at radius 118x57 px; scale = radiusTiles*45.25/118
heatRing.showWhen: player within 1.5x radius, holding a buildable or cold>=1

smoke.chimney: heat_chimney_smoke (fireplace pipe at [-4, -96], stove pipe at [1, -92] from pivot)

wind.sway: per-sprite typed sprite.sway {amp, freq, stiffness} (fragment for own props, main_pack.patch.json for trees/plants); weight = atlas masks.sway page; offset = amp * weight(sway mask or height^1.4) * (0.25 + 0.75*wind) * (sin(2pi*freq*t + phase(worldPos)) + gust); gust = 0.6*wind*smoothnoise(t*0.3 + worldX*0.05); stiffness damps high frequencies: amp *= (1 - stiffness*0.5)

particleDrift.doc: add windVec * k to particle velocity every frame; windVec = dir * wind * 40 px/s

smokeBend.doc: smoke column = puffs emitted upward; drift above makes it bend downwind. Bend angle ~ atan(wind*40 / riseSpeed); riseSpeed 22 px/s

ambientParticles.leaves: spawn wind_leaves_* off-screen upwind when wind > 0.25, rate = 4*wind per screen; autumn biome uses _autumn
ambientParticles.streaks: wind_streaks when wind > 0.4, 1 per 2 s per screen

props.windsock: anim calm (<0.15), breeze (<0.6), gust (>=0.6); rotate/flip by wind direction

splashes.ratePerScreen: rain * 60 /s on ground tiles; the renderer's GPU splashes remain the bulk, these are the close-up hero splashes

puddles.anim: idle when dry-ish, ripple layered on top while raining
puddles.grow: rain accumulation: s after 30 s, m after 90 s, l after 180 s on low tiles; dry in reverse

wetGround.note: tileable across iso tiles; blend by a world-space mask so wetness can spread

snow.edges: tile_ov_snow_edge frame = bitmask of snowy neighbours: bit0 +x (SE edge), bit1 +y (SW), bit2 -x (NW), bit3 -y (NE); draw on non-snow tiles
snow.flakes: weather_snowflakes (random frame per particle, slow spin)

fog.note: drop-in replacement for the composite fbm

lightning.screenFlash: renderer: white-lilac #e8e4ff, 0.08 s up, 0.35 s decay, double-flash 40% of the time

rainbow.when: first 30-60 s after rain stops in daylight (sun elevation > 10 deg)
rainbow.placement: screen-space backdrop on the far side of the camera, behind fog

stars.use: reflections in water tiles + menu/backdrop sky; alpha = 1 - daylight

windowGlow.pick: piece key + '_lit'; anim by wall face (left = +y wall, right = +x wall); shutters use *_open when the piece door state is open
windowGlow.anchor: window bottom-centre on the wall_window face (opening socket kind 3)
windowGlow.on: hour 18-7 when the building is occupied or has a lit heat source

food.stage: gameplay spoil stage 0 fresh, 1 stale, 2 spoiling, 3 rotten; at 100% the stack becomes item 'rot'
food.icons: food_<itemKey>. Anim 'stages' has 4 frames, frame index == stage (fps 1, loop false): registry.frame(id, 'stages', 0, stage). Named aliases fresh/stale/spoiling/rotten = the same frames; anim order is stages, fresh, stale, spoiling, rotten so animList[stage + 1] also works.
food.waterFlask: food_water_flask: 'stages' = freshness (clear -> cloudy -> murky -> pond soup); 'fill' = 4 frames, index 0 full, 1 two-thirds, 2 one-third, 3 empty (fresh water). Use fill for the thirst-charge UI if water never spoils.
food.rot: item 'rot' -> sprite 'rot' (anim idle): cute compost lump
food.badges: food_badge_<stage name> (bottom-right corner, draw over any item icon)
food.overlays: food_overlay_fuzz light|heavy for icons without staged art; food_overlay_stink animated
food.flies: fx_flies over rotten food lying in the world
